title: PositionSnapshotRequest
description: Dashboard live-marks input. The tenant-dashboard BFF (a Temporal CLIENT, which cannot dispatch an Activity directly) starts the short-lived PositionSnapshotWorkflow with this request; the workflow dispatches ReconciliationExecActivity.brokerListOpenPositions to the broker-<broker_target> task queue and returns the broker-held positions WITH their live marks (current_price / unrealized_pl / unrealized_intraday_pl). Mirrors AccountSnapshotRequest. The marks are account-level broker truth (shared across tenants on a broker_target), never a risk-gate input — tenant_id/strategy_id are forward-compat filter hooks the single-account Alpaca adapter ignores today.

broker_target.description: Routes the brokerListOpenPositions Activity to the broker-<value> task queue, mirroring AccountSnapshotRequest.broker_target.

tenant_id.description: Optional forward-compat filter hook passed through to brokerListOpenPositions. The single-account Alpaca adapter ignores it today (positions are account-level); future multi-account brokers will filter on it.

strategy_id.description: Optional forward-compat filter hook passed through to brokerListOpenPositions. Ignored by the single-account Alpaca adapter today.

correlation_id.description: Optional cross-event correlation key for tracing the dashboard read.
